title: FM27 Wonderkids — Database Values Read 13 November 2026
description: FM27 wonderkids with current database values: Max Dowman, Rio Ngumoha, Ayyoub Bouaddi, Luka Vušković and the expensive end of the list, with CA, PA, wage, value and cost as the source lists them.
meta: Updated 13 November 2026 · Values read from sortitoutsi's FM27 list on 13 November 2026 · Database figures, not in-game scouting reports; check them in your own save before you budget.
body:
Start with the four who are buyable, not with the two who are not. Every FM27 wonderkid list opens with Lamine Yamal and Pau Cubarsí, and neither is a realistic signing for a normal save. The names worth scouting are further down: Max Dowman, Rio Ngumoha, Ayyoub Bouaddi and Luka Vušković.

Values below are from sortitoutsi's FM27 list, read on 13 November 2026, the first week of the released game. Ages follow the list's in-game reference date. CA and PA are database numbers, not a scouting verdict — a PA range means two new saves can develop the same player differently.

Buyable candidates

Rio Ngumoha17Liverpool · AM RL135160–190£1k£45m£128m30-06-2028
Ayyoub Bouaddi18Man City · DM, M C143170–200£100k£67m£254m30-06-2031
Luka Vušković19Brighton · D C142178£67k£62m£200m30-06-2031

The cost column is the source's asking-price estimate, not the value column. For Dowman the two numbers are close (£53m cost against £32m value); for Ngumoha they diverge badly (£128m cost against £45m value), which is the seller pricing potential rather than the player you get today. Budget on cost plus wages, never on value.

These are listed so you can see where the buyable names sit relative to the top of the database, not as transfer targets. A 180 CA 19-year-old at Barcelona is not moving to a mid-table save at any price the game will accept.

How to check the list in your own save

  1. Confirm the database. These are the values of the shipped FM27 database. A custom database or an editor file changes them.
  2. Search the name, not the list. If a player is missing, check your loaded leagues and database size before assuming the list is wrong.
  3. Read CA and PA together. CA 135 at 17 with a 160–190 PA range is a project; CA 165 at 19 with a fixed 185 is already a starter. The first needs minutes you may not have.
  4. Scout for your squad, not for the list. Star ratings are relative to your club. A five-star rating at a lower-league club is not the same player as a three-star at a top club.
  5. Check the contract column before you bid. A 2028 expiry is a negotiating position; a 2031 expiry is a wall.

What this page does not claim

It does not rank players across positions, does not call any of them a bargain, and does not treat a PA range as a promise — a range exists precisely because development is not fixed. The source list still carries a banner warning that its early FM27 guides may be inaccurate; the values here were read after release, but a list page can lag the database it describes. Re-read the player in your own save before committing a budget.
